DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どうされましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道の掲示板に、誰が書いたか分からない警告の紙がありました。近所へ写真を広める前に、状況を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出所不明警告紙の写真を近所へ拡散前に相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a warning notice on a street bulletin board, but I don't know who wrote it. Before sharing a photo around the neighborhood, I'd like to discuss the situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want advice before circulating a photo of a warning notice of unknown origin to neighbors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような内容で、どこにありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did it say, and where was it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅の北側の掲示板です。「注意」と大きく書かれていますが、発行者や日付は見当たりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅北掲示板注意表記で発行者日付未発見と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was on the bulletin board north of the station. “Caution” was written in large letters, but I couldn't find an issuer or date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the notice said caution on the board north of the station, with no issuer or date found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紙だけを見て、実際に起きたことまで分かったわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Seeing the paper alone doesn't mean you know what actually happened, does it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。何か起きる場面は見ていません。強い言葉が書かれているので、事実と決めて人に伝えそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実際の出来事未目撃で文の強さから事実と考えそうと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Right. I haven't witnessed anything happening. Because the wording was strong, I nearly told others it was an established fact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you witnessed no event but nearly treated the strong wording as fact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真は、相談の資料として見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you show the photo as material for this consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。写真を見せることと、私が警告の内容を確かめたことは別です。撮った場所と時間も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真提示と内容検証は別で撮影場所時間も伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. Showing a photo is different from having verified the warning's contents. I'll also tell you where and when I took it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that presenting the photo is separate from verifying the contents, and you will give the place and time taken.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報を伺います。勝手に掲示を剥がさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take those details. Please don't remove the notice on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。剥がしたり文言を付け足したりせず、今見た状態を伝えます。確認前の写真を近所へ拡散するのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 剥離追記拡散せず見た状態を報告すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't remove it or add wording, and will describe the state I saw. I won't circulate the unverified photo to neighbors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report what you saw without removing, adding to or circulating the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 掲示の場所と、発行者や日付が見当たらなかったことを承りました。写真は相談資料として確認し、元のデータはお手元に残してください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted the notice's location and that you couldn't find an issuer or date. We'll check the photo as consultation material; please keep the original data yourself. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便について何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へ返す鍵を封筒に入れましたが、角に鍵の形が出ています。このまま送ると破れそうなので、発送前に包み直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒の角に鍵の形が出て破れそうなので発送前に包み直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put a key I'm returning to a friend in an envelope, but its shape is showing at a corner. It might tear if sent like this, so I'd like to repackage it before posting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the key's shape is showing at the envelope's corner and might tear it, so you want to repackage before sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒に穴は開いていますか。鍵を取り出す時は落とさないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there already a hole in the envelope? Be careful not to drop the key when taking it out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ穴はありませんが、角の紙が薄くなっています。ここで鍵を机に置きっぱなしにせず、自分の手元で取り出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 穴はまだないが角の紙が薄く鍵を自分の手元で取り出すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No hole yet, but the paper at the corner is getting thin. I'll take the key out and keep it with me, rather than leave it on the desk here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that there is no hole yet but the corner is thinning, and you will take the key out while keeping it in your possession.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鍵の先が直接紙に当たらないようにする必要があります。保護に使える物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The key's tip must not press directly against the paper. Do you have anything to protect it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 柔らかい布を持っています。ただ、布だけで先が出ないか確かめ、足りなければ家で別の保護材を用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手持ちの布で先が出ないか確認し不足なら家で保護材を用意すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a soft cloth. I'll check that the tip doesn't stick through the cloth alone, and if it isn't enough, prepare other protective material at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check whether the tip protrudes through your cloth and prepare protection at home if it is insufficient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包み直した後は、傷んだ封筒も交換してから発送の相談をしてください。受取人は発送を待っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After repackaging, replace the damaged envelope too before discussing shipment. Is the recipient waiting for it to be sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日送ると伝えてありますが、まだ出していないと連絡します。急ぐために傷んだ封筒へ戻して送ることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人にまだ発送していないと連絡し傷んだ封筒へ戻して急送しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I told my friend I'd send it today, but I'll let them know I haven't sent it yet. I won't put it back in the damaged envelope and rush to send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your friend it is not yet sent, and won't rush it out in the damaged envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。鍵をなくさないよう持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Can you take the key home without losing it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、取り出した鍵はこの留め具のある袋へしまいます。家で保護材と新しい封筒を用意し、包んだ状態で発送方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鍵を留め具のある袋にしまい家で保護材と新しい封筒を用意すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll put the removed key in this bag with a fastener. At home I'll prepare protective material and a new envelope, then ask about mailing methods with it packaged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will put the key in a fastened bag and prepare protection and a new envelope at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は発送を見合わせる形で承りました。鍵は袋にしまい、傷んだ封筒とは分けてお持ち帰りください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted that you are postponing shipment today. Please put the key in the bag and take it home separately from the damaged envelope. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相談を始める前に、待合席へ置いた袋を取りに戻りたいです。ここへ呼ばれた時に、上着の袋だけ置いて来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓口へ呼ばれ上着袋を待合に残したので相談前に取りに戻りたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before starting the consultation, I'd like to go back for a bag I left in the waiting area. When I was called here, I left behind just the bag containing my jacket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you left your jacket bag in the waiting area when called to the counter and want to retrieve it before the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know where the bag is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口側の椅子の下です。今もあるかは見えませんが、置いた場所は覚えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口椅子下に置いたが現存は未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Under the chair near the entrance. I can't see whether it's still there, but I remember where I put it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you left it under the chair by the entrance but haven't confirmed it is still there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。書類や貴重品をこちらに置いたままにしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Please don't leave documents or valuables here unattended.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。財布と書類は持って戻ります。すぐだからと、窓口へ広げたまま離れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 財布書類を窓口へ残さず持って戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll take my wallet and documents with me. I won't walk away leaving them spread on the counter just because it'll be quick.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take your wallet and documents rather than leave them at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戻られたらお知らせください。袋が見当たらなければ係へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let me know when you return. If the bag isn't there, consult a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。似た袋を見てすぐ持ち上げず、自分が結んだ白いひもも確かめます。見つからなければ戻って報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 白いひもなど自袋特徴を見て不在なら報告すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't immediately pick up a similar-looking bag; I'll also check the white string I tied on mine. If I can't find it, I'll return and report that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check identifying features such as your white string and report if your bag is missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでお待ちします。ご相談の用件は戻ってから伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll wait here. We'll discuss your consultation after you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋を確認して持って来ました。こちらに上着が入っています。書類も手元にそろったので、改めて相談を始めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自袋を回収して上着書類がそろい相談再開したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked and brought my bag back. My jacket is inside. I have my documents with me too, so I'd like to start the consultation now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you retrieved your own bag and now have your jacket and documents ready to resume the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋が見つかり、書類もそろいましたね。準備の確認はこれで済みました。お知らせいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your bag was found and your documents are together. That completes the preparation check. Thank you for letting me know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもがかごへ入れたお菓子を、私は買うと決めていません。会計の直前に取り合いにならないよう、いったんかごの内容を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子のかご入り菓子を親が未決定で会計前に内容確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child put some sweets in the basket, but I haven't decided to buy them. I'd like to check the basket now so we don't end up struggling over them just before checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the parent hasn't agreed to buy the child's basketed sweets and wants to check the contents before checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品の包装は開けていませんか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けていません。子どもには、かごに入れた時点で自分の物になったわけではないと話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 包装未開封でかご投入は所有確定でないと子へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I'll explain to my child that putting something in the basket doesn't mean it already belongs to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the packaging is unopened and you will tell your child that placing it in the basket doesn't establish ownership.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、こちらの端でご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep the aisle clear and discuss it here at the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。子どもが何を選びたかったのか聞いてから、今日買う物と予算を一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 端で希望を聞き今日購入品予算を子と確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll ask what my child wanted to choose, then check together what we're buying today and our budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that at the side you will hear your child's wishes and check today's purchases and budget together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 買わない物は、こちらでお預かりできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can take back anything you decide not to buy here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、この一つは買わないことにしました。別の棚へ隠さず、こちらへお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 買わない一つを他棚へ隠さず店員へ返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then we've decided not to buy this one. I'll return it here instead of hiding it on another shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Return the one unwanted item to the staff in Japanese rather than hide it on another shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。ほかの品はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Have you decided on the other items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。子どもと確認して、今日買う品はこちらです。会計後に店へ戻せるつもりで余分に買わず、今決めた物だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子と合意した品のみ買い後返品前提で余分を買わないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. My child and I checked, and these are today's purchases. I won't buy extras assuming I can return them after checkout; I'll buy only what we've decided now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will buy only the agreed items, not extras on the assumption of returning them later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 買わない未開封のお菓子一つは、こちらでお預かりしました。お子さんと決めた残りの商品だけをお会計します。ご確認ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've taken back the one unopened sweet you aren't buying. We'll charge only for the remaining items you and your child chose. Thank you for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。催しの受付でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you here for the event registration?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に十時出発と伝えましたが、案内には十時集合、十時半出発とありました。集合に遅れる友人へ何を伝えるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集合十時出発十時半を混同した連絡を訂正するため確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I told my friend departure was at ten, but the guide says meet at ten and depart at ten-thirty. I want to check what to tell my friend, who will be late for the meeting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check in Japanese so you can correct a message confusing the ten o'clock meeting with the ten-thirty departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人の到着は、何時頃の予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Around what time is your friend expected to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時十分です。出発後だと決めて帰るよう言う前に、集合後の受付ができるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友到着十時十分で出発済と帰らせず受付可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ten-ten. Before assuming we've already departed and telling them to go home, I'd like to know whether registration is possible after the meeting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your friend arrives at ten-ten and ask about registration rather than send them home assuming departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この催しでは、出発前に受付を済ませてください。今から来る場合は係へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this event, finish registration before departure. If they are coming now, please have them speak to staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。十時半までなら自動的に参加できるという意味でなく、着いたら受付へ確認するよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発前は自動参加可でなく到着受付確認と伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll explain that it doesn't mean automatic participation until ten-thirty; they should check at registration when they arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that before departure doesn't mean automatic participation, and your friend should check registration on arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参加者向けの説明が始まっています。友人にも後で確認してもらってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The participants' briefing has started. Please have your friend check that afterward too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。歩き始める前の説明を聞かずに追いつけばよいとは言いません。到着したら説明を確認するよう話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追いつけばよいでなく前説明を到着時確認させると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't say it's enough just to catch up without hearing the explanation before walking. I'll tell them to check the briefing when they arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that catching up isn't enough and your friend must check the preliminary explanation on arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: あなたは今、受付済みですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私は済んでいます。自分の受付を友人の分として使わず、友人が到着したら本人の受付と説明確認をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自受付済だが友に流用せず本人受付説明確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have. I won't use my registration for my friend; when they arrive, I'd like them to register personally and check the briefing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are registered but won't reuse yours for your friend, who must register and check the briefing personally.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 集合は十時、出発は十時半で、ご友人は十時十分頃の到着予定と確認できました。到着したらご本人の受付と説明の確認を係へお申し出ください。お問い合わせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed meeting at ten, departure at ten-thirty and your friend's expected arrival around ten-ten. On arrival, please ask staff about their own registration and the briefing. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰りの駅を探して写真を見せたら、出発した駅の写真でした。今朝降りた駅の写真と思い違いしたので、別の手がかりから確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰路相談写真が降車駅でなく出発駅と気付き別手掛かりを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I showed a photo to find the station for my return trip, it turned out to be my departure station. I'd mistaken it for this morning's arrival station, so I'd like to check using other clues.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the return-trip photo was the departure station, not where you got off, and ask to use other clues.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今朝は、どこで降りてから歩きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you walk after getting off this morning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 川のそばを歩きました。ただ、駅名は覚えていません。写真の駅名をそのまま降車駅として答えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 降車後川沿いだが駅名不明で写真名を流用しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Along the river. But I don't remember the station name. I won't simply give the photo's station name as where I got off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you walked along a river after getting off but don't know the station name and won't reuse the photo's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 撮った時刻や、ほかの写真も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check when the photo was taken and any other photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。駅の写真は家を出た直後で、川の写真は後でした。撮影順を見て、今朝の移動を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真時刻と順序で移動を整理すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The station photo was just after I left home; the river photo came later. I'll use the photo order to reconstruct this morning's journey.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the photo times and sequence to reconstruct your movements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今いる場所から帰る案内もできます。必ず今朝の駅へ戻りたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can also guide you home from where you are now. Do you specifically want to return to this morning's station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ駅へ戻ることが目的ではありません。家へ帰れる経路を知りたいので、今ここからの案内をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同駅へ戻るより帰宅が目的で現駅からの案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Returning to the same station isn't my goal. I want a route home, so please guide me from here now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that getting home matters more than returning to the same station, and request guidance from the current station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、現在の駅と帰宅先から調べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let's check using the current station and your destination home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。家の最寄りは郡山駅です。写真の出発駅と降車駅の混同を直し、今の駅から郡山駅へ帰る経路を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰宅先は郡山駅と伝え写真混同を直して現駅からの帰路を確認したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Kōriyama Station is nearest my home. I'll correct my confusion between the departure and arrival stations in the photo and check a route to Kōriyama from this station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that home is near Kōriyama Station and you want to correct the photo confusion and check a route from the current station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 帰宅先は郡山駅ですね。写真の駅へ戻る必要はないことを確認できました。現在地からの経路はまだご案内できていませんので、経路を確認する担当へおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your destination is Kōriyama Station. We've confirmed you don't need to return to the station in the photo. We haven't yet provided a route from here, so I'll connect you with the person who checks routes. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地域アンケートをまとめています。回答のない欄を「反対」と数えてしまったので、未回答として扱うべきか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空欄を反対に集計し未回答扱いを確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm compiling a neighborhood survey. I counted blank answers as “opposed,” so I'd like to check whether they should be treated as unanswered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you counted blank fields as opposed and want to check treating them as unanswered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 選択肢には、反対という回答欄がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is “opposed” one of the answer options?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。反対に印がある人もいます。何も書いていない人まで同じ数へ入れると、その人の意見を作ってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 反対印と空欄を混ぜると意見を作ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Some people marked opposed. Including people who wrote nothing in that same count would invent their opinions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that combining marked opposition and blank fields would invent people's opinions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 回答された内容と空欄は区別してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish the actual answers from blank fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。賛成、反対、未回答を分けて数え直します。空欄の理由も勝手に決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 賛成反対未回答を再集計し空欄理由は推測しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll recount support, opposition and no answer separately, and won't guess why a field is blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will recount support, opposition and no answer, without guessing reasons for blanks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 集計後に結果を伝えた方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you already told anyone the compiled results?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人へ一度伝えました。数字だけ直して終わらず、未回答を反対に含めた誤りも説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一度伝えた友へ数字と空欄集計の誤りを説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I told a friend once. I want to explain that I mistakenly included unanswered fields as opposition, rather than just change the numbers and leave it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell the friend previously informed both the corrected figures and the error in counting blank fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の回答は、個人情報の扱いに配慮して保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep the original responses with care for personal information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。訂正のために全員の回答写真を配るのでなく、集計方法の誤りと修正した数を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全回答写真を配らず方法誤りと修正数で訂正すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Instead of distributing photos of everyone's answers to correct it, I'll explain the counting error and the revised totals.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will correct the method and totals without distributing photos of all responses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、数え直した内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check the recounted results.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。待合で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is something troubling you in the waiting room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷房の風で少し肌寒く感じます。診察を待つ間、ひざ掛けを借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待合の冷房が肌寒いため診察までひざ掛けを借りられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The air-conditioning breeze feels a little chilly. May I borrow a lap blanket while waiting for my consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to borrow a lap blanket until your consultation because the waiting-room air conditioning feels chilly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一枚お貸しできます。風が当たりにくい席へ移ることもできますが、どうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can lend you one. You could also move to a seat less exposed to the breeze; what would you prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 席はこのままで大丈夫です。受付の近くにいたいので、ひざ掛けを一枚お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付近くの今の席を希望し移動せずひざ掛け一枚を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This seat is fine. I'd like to stay near reception, so one lap blanket, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to keep your current seat near reception and request one blanket without moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらをお使いください。使い終わりましたら職員へお返しください。床へ垂れないよう、ひざに掛けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use this. Return it to staff after use. Could you put it over your lap without letting it trail on the floor?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、端をたたんでひざに掛けます。立つ時も落とさず、席へ置き忘れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ひざ掛けの端をたたんで床へ垂らさず立つ時も落とさず置き忘れないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll fold the edge over my lap. I'll keep it from falling when I stand and won't leave it on the seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will fold the blanket's edge so it doesn't trail on the floor, drop when standing or get left behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 少しお待ちいただきましたが、何かございましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You've been waiting a little; has something happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の水のボトルを倒して、ひざ掛けを濡らしてしまいました。床にはこぼれていません。乾いた物と一緒に戻す前に、返し方を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の水でひざ掛けを濡らしたが床は濡れていないと報告し乾いた物へ戻す前に返し方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I knocked over my own water bottle and wet the lap blanket. None spilled on the floor. Before putting it back with dry ones, I'd like to ask how to return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that your water wet the blanket but not the floor, and ask how to return it before putting it with dry blankets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 濡れた一枚は職員が受け取りますので、そのままお渡しください。今、診察室からお呼びしています。新しいひざ掛けも必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Staff will take the wet blanket, so hand it over as it is. You're being called from the consultation room now. Do you also need a fresh blanket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: これから診察へ行くので、交換は不要です。この濡れた一枚をお渡しします。水のふたを閉めて、かばんと受付票を持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察へ呼ばれたので交換を断り濡れた一枚を渡して水のふたを閉め荷物と受付票を持って行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm going to the consultation now, so I don't need a replacement. I'll give you this wet one, close my water bottle and take my bag and reception slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that being called for consultation, you decline replacement, hand over the wet blanket, close the bottle and take your belongings and reception slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 濡れたひざ掛けは受け取りました。診察室へお進みください。状態を知らせてくださり、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've received the wet blanket. Please go to the consultation room. Thank you for telling us its condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: なくした物を最後に見たのは月曜日と答えましたが、今週か先週か曖昧です。曜日だけで日付を決めずに説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 最後に見た月曜が今週先週不明で日付を断定せず伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I said I last saw the lost item on Monday, but I'm unsure whether this week or last. I'd like to explain without deciding the date from the weekday alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the Monday you last saw it might be this week or last and you don't want to assert a date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 月曜日に何をしたか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember what you did on Monday?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人と昼食を取りました。同じ店へ二週続けて行ったので、店の記憶だけではどちらの週か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二週連続同店昼食で店記憶だけでは週不明と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had lunch with a friend. We went to the same restaurant two weeks in a row, so remembering the place alone doesn't tell me which week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that lunch at the same restaurant two consecutive weeks means the place alone doesn't identify the week.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真や予定表に手がかりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are there clues in photos or your calendar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その時の写真を探せます。ただ、写真に物が写っているかと撮影日を確認してから、その日まであったと言いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真の物と撮影日を確認後に最終所持日手掛かりにすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can look for a photo from then. But I want to check whether the item appears and the date taken before saying I still had it that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the item in the photo and its date before using it as a clue to the last day you had it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今、なくなったことに気付いた日時は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know when you noticed it was missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の朝です。見つからないと気付いた日は確かですが、なくした日が今日とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未所持発見は今朝確かだが紛失日が今日とは限らないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: This morning. I'm sure when I noticed I couldn't find it, but that doesn't mean today is the day I lost it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that discovery was definitely this morning, but the loss didn't necessarily occur today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その区別でお話しいただければ大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's fine to explain using that distinction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日朝の発見と、最終確認日の不確かさを分けて伝えます。写真で分かった日付があれば後で訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見日と最終確認日不明を分け写真判明後に訂正すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll separate this morning's discovery from the uncertainty about the last confirmed date. If a photo establishes a date, I'll correct it later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate discovery from the uncertain last-seen date and correct it after checking photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日の朝に気付いたことと、最後に見た日が不確かなことを分けて承りました。新しく確認できた情報があればお知らせください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've recorded separately that you noticed this morning and that the last-seen date is uncertain. Please let us know any newly verified information. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is this about mailing something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人への封筒に、いつものあだ名だけを書きました。中の手紙ではそれで呼びますが、配達先の名前は本人の正式な名前を確認した方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: あだ名だけ宛名を本文と分け正式名確認が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote only my friend's usual nickname on the envelope. I call them that in the letter, but should I check their official name for the delivery address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether a nickname-only address should be separated from the letter's wording and checked against the official name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取人の住所とお名前は確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you confirm the recipient's address and name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人が送ってくれた情報があります。私は手紙の雰囲気に合わせて、宛名まであだ名にしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の情報あり手紙の雰囲気で宛名もあだ名にしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have information they sent me themselves. To match the letter's tone, I used the nickname even on the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have the friend's own information but used their nickname on the envelope to match the letter's tone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配達先の確認できた名前を記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please enter the verified name for delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。封筒は本人から教わった名前へ直します。本文の呼び方を変えないと送れないということではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封筒名訂正し本文呼び方変更まで必要でないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll correct the envelope to the name my friend gave me. It doesn't mean I must change what I call them inside the letter in order to send it, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will correct the envelope's name and check whether changing the address term inside the letter is unnecessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本文の呼び方はご自身で決められます。宛名と差出人を整えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can choose what you call them in the letter. Let's put the recipient and sender information in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。差出人にも自分のあだ名だけでなく、確認できる名前と住所を記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出人もあだ名のみでなく名住所を記すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. For the sender too, I'll write a verifiable name and address, not just my own nickname.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that sender details will also include your name and address rather than only a nickname.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入後に、こちらで発送方法を相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After filling it in, you can discuss mailing methods here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、中の手紙と外の宛名を分けて整えます。友人があだ名を知っているから配達先も分かるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本文外宛名を分け本人が知るあだ名で配達可能と思わないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll prepare the inside letter and outside address separately. I won't assume that because my friend knows the nickname, the delivery destination can also be identified.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate the letter from the outside address and won't assume a familiar nickname is sufficient for delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 封筒には確認できた受取人と差出人の情報を書く形ですね。記入してから発送の相談へお越しください。本文の呼び方についてもご確認いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: So you'll put verified recipient and sender details on the envelope. Please come to discuss mailing after writing them. Thank you for also checking what to call your friend inside the letter.
